scope: SCVI and SysVI registration and one-epoch CPU fits on synthetic dense and sparse inputs.
build_method: Pinned build dependencies installed in a dedicated virtual environment before the hashed runtime install with build isolation disabled for that environment.
limits: One synthetic epoch tests the API, not convergence or biological validity.
The original example dataset was not inspected.
No Linux, macOS, GPU or agent evaluation.
A pinned build recipe does not establish byte-identical wheel builds.
Hosted workflow results are separate from the local controls.
